nodes.summary: Provides the computeDragConstraints helper used by draggable modals to calculate the maximum allowed drag offsets based on container and modal dimensions.

nodes.name: computeDragConstraints
nodes.summary: Calculates the top/bottom/left/right drag constraints for a modal given the container and modal dimensions, ensuring the modal stays visible.

nodes.name: posthog.test.ts

nodes.name: getProvider
nodes.summary: Looks up a single provider by its ID from the merged provider list, returning undefined if not found.
